distinctions: VALIDATION_READY is research-design maturity, not an accepted institutional assignment or permission to collect records or change operations.
Proposed owner/custodian roles and a draft request can satisfy their research checks without institutional acceptance or dispatch.
Prospective guardrail design may specify an authorized baseline-measurement and threshold-freeze sequence; it must not invent numeric thresholds or certify operational guardrail success.
Exact research eligibility rules can be prospectively defined from a retained public proposal without inventing actual asset IDs, dates or outcomes.
A successor child scope needs a distinct reviewed record and independent gate receipt before any F03 history event. Historical parent versions remain preserved.
